title.zh: Hidden Solana upgrade bug can freeze network readers and silently disable fee limits
title.en: Hidden Solana upgrade bug can freeze network readers and silently disable fee limits

current_state.zh: Solana's v1 transaction upgrade increases payload limits but risks freezing unprepared RPC readers and silently enforcing wrong fee limits for indexers and sponsors before mainnet activation.
